meta.title: Natura theme preview
meta.description: Installs the Natura theme and the Natura Core plugin from the work-in-progress branch, with demo plant guides, problem guides, and Plant Care articles.
meta.author: natura

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; wp_delete_post( 1, true ); natura_core_import_demo( 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednajack22-cell/natura/claude/site-design-ux-analysis-2hwbga/public/images' ); set_theme_mod( 'natura_hero_photo', natura_core_demo_attach_image( 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednajack22-cell/natura/claude/site-design-ux-analysis-2hwbga/public/images/natura-balcony-hero.jpg', 0, 'Tomatoes, basil, rosemary, and strawberries in terracotta pots on a sunny balcony' ) );

<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $author = (int) ( get_users( array( 'role' => 'administrator', 'number' => 1, 'fields' => 'ID' ) )[0] ?? 1 ); foreach ( natura_core_starter_guides() as $entry ) { natura_core_create_guide( $entry['kind'], $entry['slug'], $entry['guide'], 'publish', '', $author ); } flush_rewrite_rules();
